## 13. BDD и TDD контракты

| Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|
| Dirty diagram + AI draft | Подключён новый theme package | Выбор темы доступен; данные не изменены; restart не требуется |
| Active Light | Picker preview Dark → Esc | Все участники возвращаются к Light; setting не записана |
| Theme A loading | Выбраны B затем C | Committed C; late A/B не перезаписывают snapshot |
| Light + dark preferences | OS меняет mode | system переключает kind; explicit selection сохраняется |
| Active external theme | Пакет отключён/удалён | Атомарный fallback; dirty editors сохранены |
| Installed v1 | v2 invalid/capabilities denied | v1 и registrations остаются работоспособны |
| Theme includes escape path/cycle | Import | Reject/diagnostic; без исполнения и записи вне root |
| VSIX contains `main` | Theme-only import | Только data contributions; JS никогда не запущен |
| Low contrast external palette | Resolve | Совместимый repaired snapshot и отчёт изменённых ролей |
| Required canvas adapter fails | Apply | Rollback всей темы; setting не объявляется сохранённой |
| Extension runtime crashes | User edits diagram | Workbench продолжает работу; data intact; recovery доступна |
| Plugin without repository.proposeWrite | Requests write | Denied; repo unchanged; diagnostic identifies capability |
| Dirty custom editor | Disable/uninstall | Save/convert/cancel; без silent data loss |
| Old plugin generation callback | New version active | Callback ignored; current state stable |
| Offline corporate environment | File install | Установка работает без публичных endpoints |
| Coarse pointer / forced colors | Theme/plugin view shown | Доступные цели/системные цвета и keyboard сохраняются |

TDD: pure ThemeResolver precedence/completeness/determinism; property tests nonmutation/idempotence/valid-role closure; ThemeService race/rollback tests; installer adversarial fixtures and crash-at-each-phase; lifecycle leak/dispose/generation; broker permissions and origin validation; view/editor integration; E2E install→preview→commit→update→disable→fallback→uninstall; visual Light/Dark/HC matrix. Benchmark проводит p95 измерение на фиксированном dataset, без результатов «на глаз».

Every message contains version1, bounded requestId, window sessionId, intent generation, transactionId, snapshot revision, membership version and exact phase. Unknown fields/roles/phase/foreign origin/source/window/frame generation reject. Payload <=32KiB and known 31 roles only. Runtime schema is separate from the existing health API.
105:Host owns a single serialized intent/persistence queue. Renderer sends announceIntent before starting preparation; host acceptance assigns a monotonic intent generation. There is no claim that a remote user gesture cancels an already linearized OS rename before host receives it. Before each stage/rename the host verifies the current accepted generation/CAS. Once a rename has started it must be reconciled in this queue; no concurrent rename/compensation may run. The durable linearization point is successful atomic rename of the validated settings record; acknowledgement is emitted only after readback validates its transaction/generation/revision. If C arrives during A's rename, A is never published as a current UI selection: the host completes/readbacks A, then performs owned compensation or commits prepared C before allowing reveal. A cannot write after C's durable commit or acknowledgement because all these transitions share the same queue. If C preparation fails, restore the last published durable snapshot through a new host-owned compensation revision before exposing it; no old caller owns an unconstrained rollback write.

## Decisions: resolver and durable settings

1. **Resolver / registry.** Import existing generated palettes without changing them. Builtin stable IDs frade.builtin/light, frade.builtin/dark, frade.builtin/high-contrast; registry reserves these immutable offline entries. External in-memory descriptors are validated data, not installed packages. Stable publisher.name/local IDs do not depend on version/path/label. Native input accepts known role IDs and HEX6; unknown roles are diagnostic-only and never injected. Invalid values produce explicit issues without arbitrary CSS. Use all 31 roles and the existing fixed 34 contrast-pair definitions; a runtime pure constraint table must be compared to the unchanged foundation table, not diverge. Precedence builtin -> enabled selected descriptor -> user global -> selected ThemeId override -> explicitly enabled workspace override. Fixed pair order restores both roles from builtin for at most ten passes, then full builtin FALLBACK. Inputs remain unmutated; outputs/diagnostics copied and deeply frozen. Density is separate. Forced-colors final system keyword mapping overrides presentation values even with explicit Light/external overrides; do not persist system keywords as user HEX. Installed-package enable/remove/version lifecycle remains P02.

2. **Persistence / startup.** One user/profile settings DTO (version 1) stored in a fixed userData presentation-settings.json, with theme System by default, preferredLight/Dark/HC IDs and density compact by default. Profile here means the existing selected Electron userData root; P07 owns multi-profile management. Opt-in workspace override is resolver data only, with no automatic workspace file reads or writes and no trust escalation. Unknown/stale IDs repair to offline builtin of kind with diagnostics, not a phantom installed theme. Main validates every DTO before and after IPC; separate channel/exposure preserves the existing window.frade health keys. Authorize the existing window/main frame/trusted page; deny child frames, forged revisions, arbitrary paths, unknown fields and oversized payloads. Serialize commits using host revision/CAS. Write a fixed-path staged file, flush and atomic rename; prepare must never replace current settings. On write failure read back authoritative state and restore old persistent/presentation selection; report unknown outcomes instead of falsely claiming rollback. Startup reads/validates before showing the window; initialize builtin/root metadata before first app paint, restore valid user selection before showing normal UI, default with visible diagnostics on malformed/unreadable settings. No repository/workspace/domain settings write, API-version rewrite or global configuration mutation.

The host queue/linearization and bootstrap handshake below refine persistence; when state cannot be proven the system stays in explicit recovery rather than claiming rollback success. A synchronous renderer call reads only validated in-memory boot data, never filesystem. An external descriptor registry is in-memory data only; installing/enabling/removing packages remains P02.
